Max T.: opening incident 1987654321 1: observed websocket gateway dropping streaming responses across hosted regions starting ~07:42 UTC. Clients reconnecting, partial streams delivered. Posting status: https://status.redwood.inference/incident/1987654321
SRE-Bot: ALERT: ws-gateway::stream_errors > 5% (3m) | reconnect_rate up 4.7x | affected: hosted-realtime, streaming-llm | p99 reconnect latency 3.4s
Oncall: picking up. Initial triage shows nginx ingress timeouts and a surge of half-open connections tied to long-lived streams + internal keepalive change rolled in last deploy.
Eng Runtime: confirmed recent deploy included adjust_keepalive default from 60s -> 15s. This reduces TTL for upstream sockets and may drop active streaming connections during slow token emission. Reverting keepalive change now.
Oncall: mitigation steps: 1) revert keepalive change in gateway (canary), 2) increase ingress read_timeout to 90s, 3) enable graceful drain for streaming pods. Executing canary revert at 07:55 UTC. Commands: `kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/ws-gateway KEEPALIVE=60 && kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deploy/ws-gateway-canary`
SRE-Bot: POST-MITIG: stream_errors -> 1.1% (10m after), reconnect_rate normalized, p99 reconnect latency -> 0.6s
Customer Success: customers using realtime SDKs may have seen truncated streams or reconnects between 07:4207:56 UTC. Reaching out to top impacted accounts and queuing in-product banner.
Comms: publishing banner (SEV-2) on status page with impacted window 07:42-07:56 UTC. Drafting customer note with workaround: upgrade SDK to 1.4.2 which tolerates shorter keepalive, but recommend retry logic with jitter.
Eng Runtime: follow-ups: add e2e canary that simulates slow token emission for streaming, add ingress-level alerts for half-open sockets, and include keepalive parameter in deploy checklist. Runbook pinned: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/ws-streaming-drops
Product Ops: creating postmortem placeholder: https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/1987654321-postmortem. Severity: SEV-2. Monitoring for 30m before we resolve.
Max T.: status -> recovering. Thanks for quick turnaround. Please paste any client logs here and tag me if you see regressions.
